title: How the web works
goals: Name the three core web languages
body:
## How the web works Every page you visit is a conversation: 1. **Browser** asks a **server** for a resource. 2. The server responds with **HTML** (structure), often **CSS** (look), and **JavaScript** (behavior). 3. The browser paints pixels on your screen. ### Mental model Think of HTML as the skeleton, CSS as the clothes, and JavaScript as the muscles. ```html Hello Doyintech

Ship work you can show

``` ### Practice Open any website, right-click → Inspect. Find the `` tag.
videoScript: Welcome. In this lesson we map how a browser fetches HTML.
